projects.name: Nexus Vanguard
projects.author: Kerviii
projects.summary: A gaming-focused Android module for managing background activity around the gaming experience.
projects.description: Nexus Vanguard is an Android gaming module designed to manage background activity during gameplay while maintaining system stability and existing device functionality.
features: WebUI with Home, Whitelist, Profiles and About screens
Service status verified through /proc, with distinct Running, Stopped, Duplicate, Missing, Unusable, Disabled and Unknown states
Whitelist editing with validation, backup, and atomic write with rollback
Existing whitelist preserved and backed up on update
arm64-v8a only; uninstall removes only what the module can prove it owns
notes: Host-tested only. No Android device testing has been performed yet.
projects.credit: Derived from GameMode V2.0 (author field: kaminarich). Bundled binaries are included unmodified.
